name: Frostsaber Halberd's Bloodscent procs from physical periodic damage (#9909)
contract: Frostsaber Halberd's equip spell is 312688, a passive aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 312689 Bloodscent, with tiers 316688 and 320688 on the same item name. Their Spell.dbc records carry ProcFlags 0 and ProcChance 50 and the world had no spell_proc row, so Aura::GetProcEffectMask found no proc entry and the roll never ran (#9909). The tooltip promises a chance when dealing Physical damage over time. The repair grants PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC over the physical school at the hit phase and defers Chance to the record's ProcChance 50. spell_proc_chance reads the loaded entries' 50, and aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision 40000 times on a synthetic landed periodic tick naming Rend 772 (physical): about 50%; zero for a frost periodic tick (Frostbolt 116), for a physical direct hit and for a melee-class hit. Before the repair the chance lookups fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: proc dummy aura 312688 is applied
SETUP: proc dummy aura 320688 is applied
DISCRIMINATING: a physical periodic tick procs 312688 at about 50%
DISCRIMINATING: a physical periodic tick procs 320688 at about 50%
CONTROL: a frost periodic tick is not physical damage
CONTROL: a physical direct melee-class hit is not damage over time
CONTROL: a physical direct spell-class hit is not damage over time
